summary: aac-tools/ is ArgoCDTools' second image folder and its own kaniko context: ubuntu:noble with python3 3.12 + distro PyYAML, helm 4, git, bash and the homelab step-ca root, shipping the canonical arch-validate byte for byte at /usr/local/bin/arch-validate, with no ENTRYPOINT and noble's uid-1000 passwd entry for KubeCoder's toolchain contract. A closing build-time RUN asserts every declared tool plus an openssl verify of the root against the system bundle, and the kaniko build ran all of it green; the Jenkinsfile publishes :<build> and :latest beside argocd-hook and .kubecoder/project.yaml names the component. kc project lint, test and build are green from the repo root; code committed on phase/024-P2, done-record committed in AnsibleSpecs.
